Taking go right->go right->go left puts me at (0, 1) — leaving 6 step(s) to go. Taking go right->go right->go right puts me at (0, 3) — — but it's a hole, so this is off the table. go right->go right->go down looks best — only 4 step(s) left to the goal.
go right->go right->go down->go down leads to (2, 2) — 3 step(s) remaining. go right->go right->go down->go right leads to (1, 3) — 3 step(s) remaining. go right->go right->go up->go down leads to (1, 2) — 4 step(s) remaining. go right->go right->go down->go left leads to (1, 1) — a hole — I'll skip this. go right->go right->go up->go right leads to (0, 3) — a hole — I'll skip this. I'll continue with go right->go right->go down->go down; it's the closest, with 3 step(s) to go.
Following go right->go right->go down->go down->go down I'd end up at (3, 2) — with 2 step(s) still ahead. Following go right->go right->go down->go down->go left I'd end up at (2, 1) — with 4 step(s) still ahead. Following go right->go right->go down->go down->go up I'd end up at (1, 2) — with 4 step(s) still ahead. Following go right->go right->go down->go down->go right I'd end up at (2, 3) — — that's a hole, ruled out. go right->go right->go down->go down->go down gets me the furthest, leaving just 2 step(s). I'll keep this.
Going go right->go right->go down->go down->go down->go right brings me to (3, 3) — and the goal is right there. Going go right->go right->go down->go down->go down->go down brings me to (3, 2) — 2 move(s) short of the goal. Going go right->go right->go down->go down->go down->go up brings me to (2, 2) — 3 move(s) short of the goal. I'll take go right->go right->go down->go down->go down->go right; that's the goal right there.

Taking go right->go right->go down puts me at (1, 2) — leaving 4 step(s) to go. Taking go right->go right->go right puts me at (0, 3) — leaving 4 step(s) to go. Taking go right->go right->go up puts me at (0, 2) — leaving 5 step(s) to go. go right->go right->go down gets me the furthest, leaving just 4 step(s). I'll keep this.
go right->go right->go down->go down leads to (2, 2) — 3 step(s) remaining. go right->go right->go down->go right leads to (1, 3) — 3 step(s) remaining. go right->go right->go right->go down leads to (1, 3) — 3 step(s) remaining. Going with go right->go right->go down->go down for now — 3 more step(s) to the goal.
Following go right->go right->go down->go down->go right I'd end up at (2, 3) — with 2 step(s) still ahead. Following go right->go right->go down->go down->go down I'd end up at (2, 2) — with 3 step(s) still ahead. Following go right->go right->go down->go down->go up I'd end up at (1, 2) — with 4 step(s) still ahead. Following go right->go right->go down->go down->go left I'd end up at (2, 1) — — that's a hole, ruled out. go right->go right->go down->go down->go right looks best — only 2 step(s) left to the goal.
Going go right->go right->go down->go down->go right->go right brings me to (2, 4) — and the goal is right there. Going go right->go right->go down->go down->go right->go down brings me to (2, 3) — 2 move(s) short of the goal. Going go right->go right->go down->go down->go down->go right brings me to (2, 3) — 2 move(s) short of the goal. Going go right->go right->go down->go down->go down->go left brings me to (2, 1) — — into a hole, so no. go right->go right->go down->go down->go right->go right gets me to the goal, so that's my pick.
